decisions.authority: SO0 delivery/offline constitution and PC5 authorization
decisions.decision: Adopt the frozen SO0 constitutional assignment of operational idempotency, delivery, retry, notifications, integration delivery and offline synchronization to SO8 while reusing PC5 authorization.
Map the legacy helper as compatibility-only operational dedupe evidence; new SO8 commands use tenant-scoped exact request fingerprints without changing financial idempotency_records.
Bridge prospectively through SO8 public delivery contracts and provider adapters; do not bulk reinterpret legacy events or callbacks.

decisions.authority: Neutral Finance transactional outbox, provider callbacks and financial idempotency
decisions.decision: Preserve all financial delivery/idempotency/provider semantics and bytes. SO8 never claims financial settlement or outbox authority.
Retire only after source-specific callers converge on SO8 public contracts under controlled later milestones.
